title: The Design Masterprize (DMP) Award 2026
description: Enter product, graphic, or communication design work in the Design Masterprize 2026, a global design award.
descriptionDetailed: The Design Masterprize (DMP) is a global design award from the Farmani Group celebrating product, graphic, and communication design. Its third edition spans 29 categories, from automotive to UI/UX. Entries are judged online, with Best of Best and Winner distinctions. Winners receive the DMP trophy, certificates, and Book of Design inclusion.

entry.feeNote: Professional entries start at €225 and students at €50 in the early entry period; additional categories for the same entry receive a 30% discount

prize.prizeSummary: Trophy + certificate + Book of Design inclusion
prize.description: Designs of the year receive the DMP Trophy. Sub-category winners receive winner certificates, badges, inclusion in the yearly DMP Book of Design, and a feature in the Winners Gallery. Best of Best is awarded to the highest scoring winners in each main category, and Honorable Mentions acknowledge outstanding merit.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For designers, engineers, and creators worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to individuals and companies of all experience levels and ages from any country. Conceptual, in-progress, and previously awarded works are accepted.
